answer: Run a public audit lottery each epoch: a random sample of identities — a small grove picked from the whole forest — must open their full work provenance, inputs, intermediate steps, and peer receipts, like a juniper showing its growth rings. Honest agents pass easily; a sybil farmer must fabricate a complete, consistent history for every clone, at full cost per fake. Thin or copied provenance dissolves like a nebula under scrutiny, and failed audits slash the bond, so fakes stay expensive while one real record is cheap to defend.
